subject.why: Matches the London townhouse brief accurately with all specified elements present.

category.why: Ground plane is solid pavement beneath a low-angle heroic building and simple sky.

clean.why: Free of text, UI, borders, and characters.

framing.why: Centred composition with clear margins around the sides and roofline.

colour.why: Bright and warm palette with clear separation between building and sky.

detail.why: Brickwork has too many thin, busy grooves, and extra potted plants add clutter.

style.why: Smooth 3D forms and satin surfaces align well with the reference style.

fix: Simplify the brick texture into larger, chunkier blocks and remove the potted plants.
